title: Internship - Turbine Design Engineer
description: Job Description Summary At Avio Aero, a GE Aerospace company, we invent the future of flight, lift people up, and bring them home safely. We are a world-leading provider specializing in the design, production, and maintenance of components and propulsion systems for both civil and military aviation. Respect for people is core to our culture and commitment to FLIGHT DECK, our proprietary lean operating model. We attract, develop, and retain industry-leading talent from all backgrounds and cultivate communities where people are respected and empowered to reach their fullest potential. For the people of GE Aerospace, their work isn't just a job. It's their passion and purpose. We work and win as one team, accountable to each other and our customers, and we are always finding a better way to climb higher together. We were meant to fly. We are looking for an extracurricular intern within the Campania Engineering Center, at Avio Aero, a GE Aerospace company. As Intern - Turbine Design Engineer you will work as part of an integrated global team. You will contribute to the design, development and field sustain of Turbine Modules. The activities will be focused on Life of Cycle of products support, from manufacturing and field perspective. Job Description Essential Responsibilities: Lean how to work on CAD models and drawings Perform structural and fracture mechanics analyses in support of MRB, DR dispositions, producibility and cost-out projects Support manufacturing shop to improve producibility of components for which he has design responsibility Proactively support and contribute to the coordination of activities with other Company departments (Program management, Sourcing, Quality and Global Supply Chain) Learn how to interface with Customers and Suppliers in order to implement product improvements (e.g. concurrent design, cost-out activities) Communicate with the team to improve collaboration and eliminate waste. Share information and promote open dialogue. Required Qualifications Master's Degree in Engineering (Aeronautical/Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering preferred) Passion for technical excellence and technology advancement Self-directed and motivated Open mindset and strong team player Clear thinking and diligent approach Fluent English and Italian Good interpersonal and communication skills Work Visa, according to local regulation, is required Desired Characteristics Experience with CAD/CAE tools Good knowledge of Turbine Modules and components Creativity and curiosity Capable of working in multicultural environment, preferable previous international experience Analytical thinking skills System mindset and problem solver Join us! Avio Aero is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to fostering a culture of respect, where every individual is valued, supported, and empowered to thrive. Employment decisions are made based on merit, qualifications, and business needs. Join us and be part of a team where your talent, ideas, and ambition can help shape the future of flight. Apply now and see your career take flight! Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No
